android.desc:
This game includes optional in-game purchases, including random virtual items.
What seemed to be independent cases slowly begins to link together and form a larger picture.
The hand behind it all has no regards for social order and aims only to destroy all that is decent and good.
As the truth becomes more obscure and shrouded in mystery, the lines between good and evil blurs. With the world against you and the words of reason falling on deaf ears...
Will you still be determined to stand by your choices and beliefs? 

Tears of Themis is a legal romance and detective mobile game where players take on the role of a rookie attorney who, while working alongside the male leads to solve mysterious cases, becomes entangled in hidden conspiracies. This is an adventure of romance × wits. What choice will you make?

◆Exquisite Dynamic Illustrations - Capture every moment
The exquisite Dynamic Illustrations brings cards to life, each featuring a storyline that forever frames your treasured memory with him in vivid detail.

◆Evidence Collection - Search the scene and uncover the truth
Discover delicate evidence and experience the freedom of 3D investigation at the crime scene. Analyze evidence and compare testimonies to contradicting clues found to uncover the key evidence. Uncover the truth through meticulous investigations, logic, and wits.

◆Exclusive Companionship: Step by Step into His Heart
Dive into a captivating story and uncover a new side of him! Enter his inner world one step at a time, share intimate moments, and feel the warmth of romance at your fingertips.

◆Intimate Interaction - Immersive Romantic Experience
Trigger exclusive story events and get personal video calls from him! Hear his charming voice, see his everyday gestures, and experience the thrill of romance. Enjoy close interactions, memorable dates, and let your heart flutter with love!
